title: How To Hide Top-Level Category From Member's Profile Page | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How To Hide Top-Level Category From Member's Profile Page Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000084651 In order to hide the top-level category from the member's profile page: Navigate to Settings - Advanced Settings and search for " Hide Top-Level Category on Member Profile Page ": When this advanced setting is enabled, the top-level category that displays on the member profile under the name is removed: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
